items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: Fill in the booking form on this page and it opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send. Tiana will confirm your slot within 24 hours.

items.question: Where are you located?
items.answer: Nail Lovers by Tiana is based in Lagos, Nigeria. Message us on WhatsApp for the exact address and directions once you book.

items.question: Which services do you offer?
items.answer: Acrylic full sets, custom nail art and design, gel manicures, classic, hybrid and volume lash extensions, nail infill and removal, and complete bridal packages.

items.question: Can I bring a design inspiration?
items.answer: Yes. Send your inspiration pictures on WhatsApp or bring them to your appointment and Tiana will recreate or adapt them for you.

items.question: How long do nails and lashes last?
items.answer: Gel manicures stay beautiful for weeks, and clients regularly enjoy their lash sets for around three weeks with proper care. Infills keep acrylics fresh between sets.

items.question: Do you offer bridal packages?
items.answer: Yes. The bridal package includes a consultation, a trial session and the day of application for both nails and lashes.

items.question: How do I get prices?
items.answer: Prices are listed on each service where available. For custom designs or packages, message us on WhatsApp for a quote.
